title: 第237章  倒悬钟！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陆沉会面对的，未必比天峰山轻松。

但宋青山相信他。

因为陆沉是那种越乱越冷的人。

刀在乱局里，反而最容易找到该斩的线。

上午，顾沉舟也准备回守山台。

他伤势不轻，沈冰心原本不许他动。

但顾沉舟坚持要去确认旧阵。

最后沈冰心退了一步。

宋青山陪他去。

黑虎开车。

秦老随行。

顾沉舟坐在后座，脸色苍白，却抱着摄魂铃不放。

宋青山看了他一眼。

“你现在离不开它？”

顾沉舟道：“不是离不开。”

“是死门还不稳。”

宋青山道：“也不是你一个人的死门。”

顾沉舟沉默片刻。

“我知道。”

“但父骨和母发都在守山台。”

“昨夜虽然旧阵护住了，可我不亲眼看看，不安心。”

宋青山没有再劝。

他理解顾沉舟。

失去二十三年后，好不容易把亲人的遗骨遗物带回旧地，谁都无法真的放心。

车到半山腰，众人步行上守山台。

昨日的战斗痕迹仍在。

山路上有尸傀焚烧后的黑痕，石阶边缘被撞碎几处，空气里残留淡淡焦臭。

守山台祭坛还在。

旧阵暗红光芒微弱，却没有断。

顾怀山遗骨木盒安静放在安骨位。

母发玉瓶也完好无损。

顾沉舟走到祭坛前，缓缓跪下。

这一次，他没有说太多话。

只是将额头贴在冰冷石台上。

宋青山和秦老都没有打扰。

黑虎站得远远的，连呼吸都放轻了。

顾沉舟起身时，眼眶微红，但神色比来时安定。

“旧阵还在。”

宋青山点头。

“茶会后，我们暂时赢了。”

顾沉舟看向死门方向。

“只是暂时。”

“嗯，只是暂时。”

顾沉舟抬手，摄魂铃轻轻一响。

死门方向没有回声。

至少此刻，没有。

顾沉舟低声道：“我要在守山台留一夜。”

宋青山皱眉。

顾沉舟道：“不是逞强。”

“旧阵昨日被冲击过，我需要把它重新补稳。”

“父骨和母发也需要安魂。”

宋青山看着他。

顾沉舟补充：“我会让秦老守在外侧，不深入死门。”

秦老在旁边道：“宋先生放心，老夫盯着他。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

What Lu Chen will face may not be as easy as Tianfeng Mountain.

But Song Qingshan believed in him.

Because Lu Chen is the kind of person who gets more chaotic and cold.

In a chaotic situation, it is easiest for a knife to find the line to cut.

In the morning, Gu Chenzhou was also preparing to return to Shoushan Terrace.

His injury was serious, and Shen Bingxin originally did not allow him to move.

But Gu Chenzhou insisted on confirming the old formation.

Finally, Shen Bingxin took a step back.

Song Qingshan went with him.

Black Tiger drives.

Mr. Qin accompanied him.

Gu Chenzhou was sitting in the back seat, his face was pale, but he was holding on to the Soul Seizing Bell.

Song Qingshan glanced at him.

"You can't live without it now?"

Gu Chenzhou said: "It's not that we can't live without each other."

"The door to death is not yet stable."

Song Qingshan said: "It is not your death alone."

Gu Chenzhou was silent for a moment.

"I know."

"But the father's bones and mother's hair are both at Shoushantai."

"Although the old formation protected it last night, I won't feel at ease unless I see it with my own eyes."

Song Qingshan did not persuade him again.

He understood Gu Chenzhou.

Twenty-three years after the loss, no one can really feel relieved to finally bring the remains of their loved ones back to their old place.

When the car reached halfway up the mountain, everyone walked up to the mountain guard platform.

The traces of yesterday's battle are still there.

There are black marks on the mountain road after corpses were burned. The edges of the stone steps were smashed in several places, and a faint burnt smell lingers in the air.

The Morishantai altar is still there.

The dark red light of the old formation was weak, but it did not break.

The wooden box of Gu Huaishan's remains was quietly placed in the resting place.

The mother-hair jade bottle is also intact.

Gu Chenzhou walked to the altar and slowly knelt down.

This time, he didn't say much.

He just pressed his forehead against the cold stone platform.

Neither Song Qingshan nor Mr. Qin bothered.

Black Tiger stood far away, even breathing lightly.

When Gu Chenzhou stood up, his eyes were slightly red, but his expression was calmer than before.

"The old formation is still there."

Song Qingshan nodded.

"After the tea party, we won for now."

Gu Chenzhou looked towards the door of death.

"Only temporarily."

"Well, it's just for now."

Gu Chenzhou raised his hand and the Soul Seizing Bell rang gently.

There was no echo from the direction of Death's Gate.

At least not at the moment.

Gu Chenzhou whispered: "I want to stay at Shoushan Terrace all night."

Song Qingshan frowned.

Gu Chenzhou said: "It's not about showing off."

"The old formation was attacked yesterday, and I need to replenish it."

"The father's bones and mother's hair also need to be requiemed."

Song Qingshan looked at him.

Gu Chenzhou added: "I will ask Mr. Qin to stay on the outside and not go deep into the door of death."

Mr. Qin said from the side: "Don't worry, Mr. Song, I'm keeping an eye on him."
